en.title: How to Turn Your English Name into a Japanese or Chinese Seal
en.excerpt: Learn how to turn an English name into a custom name seal using alphabet letters, initials, katakana, kanji, or Chinese characters.
en.meta_description: Turn an English name into a Japanese or Chinese seal. Compare kanji seals, custom name seals, Japanese name stamps, katakana, initials, and characters.
en.image_alt: A natural stone name seal with alphabet letters, katakana, and Chinese characters on paper.
